remarks: Nearly brand-new end-unit townhome in one of Ellicottville’s most desirable developments, offering an exceptional combination of location, style and four-season convenience. Beautifully furnished and move-in ready, this bright and spacious townhome features all new furnishings and appliances throughout. A walk-in foyer leads into an impressive open-concept main level designed for gathering and entertaining. The stunning kitchen offers all the amenities, including a large eat-at island with built-in storage that opens to the dining and living areas. Relax around the attractive gas fireplace or step outside to the patio and enjoy the summer weather. A convenient half bath completes the first floor. Upstairs are three generously sized bedrooms, including an attractive primary suite with a private bath featuring a walk-in shower and a spacious walk-in closet. An additional den area is large enough for a sofa, chair and large TV, creating a perfect second living or entertainment space. The home comfortably sleeps eight people, with a pull-out sofa providing accommodations for two more guests. An attached garage/storage area adds even more convenience for skis, bikes and all your four-season gear. Located approximately one minute from the Village of Ellicottville’s shops, restaurants and entertainment and just five minutes from both ski areas, mountain biking and year-round recreation. Bright, spacious and beautifully appointed, this spectacular townhome is ready for you to move in and start enjoying the Ellicottville lifestyle before ski season.
